§7.2.12 Underlined Text

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-underlined-text · text formatting inline

✅ Normative

Underlined text MUST be wrapped in <u>…</u>. The output MUST NOT use <ins>, and MUST NOT use _ text _.

subject to the <u>prior written consent</u> of the lessor

Markdown has no underline of its own, so the HTML element is used.

Why not the alternatives

<ins> means inserted text — an edit-history claim that a plain underline on a page does not make. _ text _ collides with Markdown emphasis and renders as italics.

Underline in a redline

An underline-only replacement in a redlined table — a new figure underlined in place of a struck one — is still written <u>1.335</u>, next to the struck value. See Struck and Replaced Values§9.6.7 for how the pair is encoded.
